title.suggested: East St. Louis Mayor Stops Boxing Exhibition Billed with Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that a boxing entertainment at Flannigan's hall in East St. Louis, billed with Tom Allen and Tom Kelly as veterans, was abandoned after the mayor ordered police to stop it.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Friday Morning, March 30, 1883', page 6.

facts.fact: Allen, billed as 'the retired champion of the world', was advertised for a grand athletic entertainment at Flannigan's hall, East St. Louis, which Tom Kelly abandoned after the mayor's proclamation against it
places: Flannigan's hall, East St. Louis, Illinois

notes: Same event as 692. Allen is named only in the quoted poster.
